remarks: Charming Single-Story Anaheim Home with Great Potential!  An excellent opportunity to own a 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in a convenient central Anaheim location! Offered for sale by its original owner, this home features approximately 1,291 sq. ft. of living space on a spacious 6,380 sq. ft. lot. New windows installed in 2024 provide a recent improvement, while the home offers an opportunity for additional updates and personal touches. Conveniently located near Disneyland, shopping, dining, entertainment, and minutes away from freeways. Whether you're looking for a home to personalize or a property with renovation potential, this Anaheim home is worth exploring. Don't miss this opportunity!
